tools/ci/reading_stack.py.rationale: F39 hardware-only compiler stack-use gate for fixed personal/stats workspaces; emits stack usage evidence and fails frames above 256 bytes without changing runtime behavior. No SDK, transport or UI dependency. R1 also emits frame evidence and rejects reminder worker frames above its one-record 1 KiB scratch limit. F40w week/streak projections and stats workspace also enforce the 256-byte compiler frame bound.

tools/ci/simulator_build.py.rationale: F02 Linux-only compatibility hook for the pinned simulator: Arduino timing declarations, crypto link ordering and private checksum fallback symbols. No product transport or persistence.

pinned.rationale: SDK source/resources are immutable inputs, isolated behind HAL and renderer wrappers. New product UI has no SDK include path. Pin or input changes require boundary review.

policy: New/stale production inputs and changed retained include edges fail. Review the dependency rationale for every inventory change. Product roles are path-owned, not exemptions.
